# Observational CHIRPS / CHIRTS-era5 — QAQC sandbox

Throwaway sandbox notebook for inspecting the freshly-published observational
parquets on S3. Not wired into the published Atlas site; render on demand only.

## Data consumed

Two parquets, both at the `domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/` root on `digital-atlas`:

- `processing=admin-monthly/variable=adm0_obs.parquet` — one row per (zone × year × month × variable), 1980–2026.
- `processing=admin-periods/variable=adm0_obs.parquet` — one row per (zone × year × period × variable). `period` is season (`annual` + 12 rolling 3-month seasons JFM…DJF), **not** baseline.

## Source attribution (per variable)

`source = 'chirps-chirts-era5'` is a single combined string in the parquet, but it actually means **two distinct sources**:

- **PTOT**: [CHIRPS](https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps) (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data)
- **TAVG / TMAX / TMIN**: [CHIRTS-era5](https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirtsdaily) (CHIRTS temperature, ERA5-based version)
- **SPEI-01 / 03 / 06 / 12 / 24**: derived from CHIRPS precipitation + PET computed from CHIRTS-era5 temperatures

## Known QAQC flags (Stage 1)

1. **Disputed-territory polygons** (CR-075): EGY ships 3 adm0 polygons (Egypt + Bīr Ṭawīl + Hala'ib), KEN ships 2 (Kenya + Ilemi), SDN ships 2 (Sudan + Abyei). This sandbox filters to the main-country polygon (the `gaul0_code` with the largest admin1 count per iso3) so the disputed-territory rows are dropped from the plots below. Long-term fix is pipeline-side (see CR-075).
2. **Non-finite SPEI values** (Inf at distribution tails) in admin-monthly: SPEI-01 0.15% → SPEI-24 4.4% of rows. SPEI tail issue, not data corruption — happens when the log-logistic fit blows up at extreme drought/wet years. Filtered to NA before plotting. The admin-periods parquet has already cleaned these via the Inf-strict aggregation fix in upstream `d1fc80d`.
3. **Naming gotcha**: the column is `value_mean` for all variables, but at the admin-periods grain it carries the **aggregation result per variable** (sum for PTOT, mean for TAVG/SPEI, max for TMAX, min for TMIN). Same column name regardless. Spot-checked: annual TAVG = average-of-12-months, annual PTOT = sum-of-12-months.
4. **`source` column** is the combined string `'chirps-chirts-era5'` (one value), so the parquet itself doesn't attribute per variable. See "Source attribution" above for the breakdown.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
obsBase = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/";
monthlyAdm0URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-monthly/variable=adm0_obs.parquet";
periodsAdm0URL = obsBase + "processing=admin-periods/variable=adm0_obs.parquet";

// DuckDB-WASM ships with httpfs built-in — no INSTALL/LOAD needed
// (that would fail at runtime since WASM extensions are compile-time).
db = await DuckDBClient.of();
```

```{ojs}
// Hardcoded country selector (sandbox scope). The full notebook will
// reuse components/_adminSelectors; here we only need 3 known countries
// to spot-check observational data quality.
countries = [
  { iso3: "AGO", name: "Angola"  },
  { iso3: "TGO", name: "Togo"    },
  { iso3: "KEN", name: "Kenya"   },
];

viewof country = Inputs.select(countries, {
  label: "Country",
  format: (d) => `${d.iso3} — ${d.name}`,
});
```

```{ojs}
// CR-075 short-term filter — pick the main-country gaul0_code per iso3
// (the one with the largest admin1 count). Disputed-territory polygons
// each carry exactly 1 admin1, so this reliably drops Bīr Ṭawīl /
// Hala'ib / Ilemi / Abyei from the adm0 query results.
mainGaul = {
  const resp = await db.query(`
    WITH per_polygon AS (
      SELECT iso3, gaul0_code, COUNT(DISTINCT admin1_name) AS n_admin1
      FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm0URL.replace("adm0_obs", "adm1_obs")}')
      GROUP BY iso3, gaul0_code
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT iso3, gaul0_code,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iso3 ORDER BY n_admin1 DESC) AS rn
      FROM per_polygon
    )
    SELECT iso3, gaul0_code FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  `);
  const map = new Map();
  for (const row of resp) map.set(row.iso3, row.gaul0_code);
  return map;
}
```

## Section A — Monthly precipitation (PTOT)

```{ojs}
ptot_monthly = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return [];
  const resp = await db.query(`
    SELECT year, month,
           CAST(year AS DOUBLE) + (CAST(month AS DOUBLE) - 1) / 12.0 AS year_frac,
           value_mean
    FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm0URL}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
      AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
      AND variable = 'PTOT'
      AND value_mean IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite(value_mean)
    ORDER BY year, month
  `);
  return Array.from(resp);
}

ptot_plot = Plot.plot({
  width: 1200,
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 60,
  marginBottom: 50,
  style: { color: "#333" },
  x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: (d) => `${d}` },
  y: { label: "Precipitation (mm / month)", grid: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#999", strokeWidth: 0.5 }),
    Plot.line(ptot_monthly, {
      x: "year_frac",
      y: "value_mean",
      stroke: "#4FB5B7",
      strokeWidth: 1,
    }),
  ],
});
```

## Section C — Period means per (period × variable)

Annual + 12 rolling 3-month seasons. PTOT is summed across a period's months; TAVG / SPEI are averaged. Each dot is the per-year period value; horizontal bars mark the 1995–2014 mean for that (period × variable) cell, so you can eyeball anomalies year-on-year.

```{ojs}
periods_data = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return [];
  const resp = await db.query(`
    SELECT period, variable, year, value_mean
    FROM read_parquet('${periodsAdm0URL}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
      AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
      AND variable IN ('PTOT', 'TAVG', 'SPEI-12')
      AND value_mean IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite(value_mean)
    ORDER BY variable, period, year
  `);
  return Array.from(resp);
}

// Compute 1995–2014 baseline mean per (variable × period) for reference lines
baselines = {
  const rows = periods_data.filter((d) => d.year >= 1995 && d.year <= 2014);
  const grouped = d3.rollup(
    rows,
    (v) => d3.mean(v, (d) => d.value_mean),
    (d) => `${d.variable}|${d.period}`,
  );
  return Array.from(grouped, ([key, mean]) => {
    const [variable, period] = key.split("|");
    return { variable, period, mean };
  });
}

periodOrder = ["annual","DJF","JFM","FMA","MAM","AMJ","MJJ","JJA","JAS","ASO","SON","OND","NDJ"];

periods_plot = Plot.plot({
  width: 1200,
  height: 600,
  marginLeft: 80,
  marginRight: 30,
  marginBottom: 50,
  marginTop: 30,
  style: { color: "#333" },
  facet: { data: periods_data, x: "variable", y: "period" },
  fx: { label: null },
  fy: { domain: periodOrder, label: null, tickFormat: (d) => d },
  x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: (d) => `${d}` },
  y: { label: null, grid: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(periods_data, {
      x: "year",
      y: "value_mean",
      r: 1.5,
      fill: "#4FB5B7",
      opacity: 0.7,
    }),
    Plot.ruleY(baselines, { y: "mean", stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "2,2" }),
  ],
});
```

## Section D — Climatology COG spot checks

The climatology side of the publish — `processing=climatology/{variable}/{period}/{clim}/{stat}/*.tif` — has its own QAQC story. 1,404 COGs total (9 variables × 13 periods × 3 climatologies × 4 stats). All sit on S3 alongside the parquets.

### Raster contents are sound

Spot-checked three COGs (`annual_1995-2014_mean.tif` for PTOT, TAVG, SPEI-12) with `gdalinfo`:

| variable | min | max | range plausible? |
|---|---|---|---|
| PTOT annual mean | 0.045 mm/yr | 5,195 mm/yr | ✓ Sahara → equatorial rainforest |
| TAVG annual mean | 5.57 °C | 36.84 °C | ✓ Atlas / Ethiopian highlands → Sahara |
| SPEI-12 annual mean | −0.50 | +0.49 | ✓ z-score, ≈0 over reference period |

All COGs: 1500×1600 px, 0.05° resolution, WGS84, Africa bounding box (20°W → 55°E, 40°S → 40°N), Float32, 512×512 tiled blocks, NoData = `nan`. Standard COG layout.

Country-cropped thumbnails (`gdalwarp -te <country bbox>` → `gdaldem color-relief <ramp>` → `gdal_translate -of PNG -outsize 500 0`). **Responds to the country selector above** — choose AGO / TGO / KEN to switch all three maps. Ramps: PTOT sequential white→blue; TAVG sequential viridis (cool→hot); SPEI-12 diverging red-white-blue (dry→wet, centred at 0).

```{ojs}
//| output: false

    { v: "SPEI-12", label: "SPEI-12 annual mean — z-score, diverging dry↔wet" },
  ];
  return html`<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px;">
    ${variables.map(({ v, label }) => html`<figure style="margin: 0;">
      <img src="img/${iso3}_${v}_annual_1995-2014_mean.png"
           alt="${iso3} ${v} annual 1995-2014 mean"
           style="width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #fafafa;" />
      <figcaption style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #555; margin-top: 4px;">${label}</figcaption>
    </figure>`)}

}
```

Visual sanity (AGO default): PTOT shows the expected dry/wet gradient (arid south-west Namib-coastal strip → wetter interior north). TAVG shows the typical Angolan range (~20–28°C). SPEI-12 is near zero over the 1995–2014 reference period as expected. Switching to TGO shows much wetter equatorial-belt PTOT; KEN shows the cooler Highlands vs hotter arid north.

### Pipeline bug 1 — Hive partition tokens collapsed (CR-076)

**All ~1,404 COGs land in a single physical S3 directory**:

```
processing=climatology/variable=PTOT/period=AMJ/clim=wmo_1991-2020/stat=max/
  └─ PTOT_AMJ_1991-2020_mean.tif
  └─ PTOT_AMJ_1995-2014_max.tif
  └─ TAVG_annual_full_sd.tif
  └─ SPEI-12_DJF_1995-2014_min.tif
  └─ ... (all 1,404 files here)
```

Filenames carry the metadata correctly (`{var}_{period}_{clim}_{stat}.tif`) but the Hive partition tokens in the path are stuck on the first-iteration value: `variable=PTOT`, `period=AMJ`, `clim=wmo_1991-2020`, `stat=max`. Consumers using path-based partition pruning (e.g. terra::rast, DuckDB's globbed `read_parquet`, MapLibre tile-source path lookups) won't find files at the "right" partition paths. Workaround: glob the single directory and parse the filename.

Probable cause: the publish step's `name_fn` (per the hazards_prototype observational README, "translates the on-disk 4-token climatology label into the descriptive S3 partition value") sets the partition tokens once at startup based on the first file, then reuses those values for every subsequent upload instead of recomputing per-file.

### Pipeline bug 2 — Stats metadata are sentinel `-9999` (CR-076)

Every COG ships with bogus mean/stddev in the embedded stats:

```
STATISTICS_MAXIMUM = <real value>     ✓
STATISTICS_MINIMUM = <real value>     ✓
STATISTICS_MEAN    = -9999            ✗  (sentinel; never computed)
STATISTICS_STDDEV  = -9999            ✗  (sentinel; never computed)
```

GDAL writes -9999 when the bake step skips full statistics computation. Min/max were computed but mean/stddev were not. Downstream consumers that read embedded stats to set colour-scale defaults will pick up the bogus -9999 and break.

Both pipeline bugs filed as **CR-076** — bundle into the next hazards_prototype dispatch alongside CR-068 / CR-064 / CR-075.

## Section E — Recent Changes (observational replacement, drop-in candidate)

Prototype drop-in replacement for the existing `barplot_recentChanges` / `warmingStripes_recentChanges` plots in the main `climateRationale` notebook. Driven by observational CHIRPS v3 + CHIRTS-ERA5 monthly admin1 parquet (not the NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 hindcast).

**Design rules** (per the 2026-05-20 dispatch):
- Baseline window: **1991-2020 exclusively** (matches WMO normals + SPEI standardisation).
- **No per-year ±SD ribbon** — observational data is a single realisation, not an ensemble. Uncertainty is rendered as horizontal reference bands centred on the 1991-2020 mean.
- **Temperature (TMAX/TMIN/TAVG) and PTOT**: ±1σ band ≈ normal year-to-year variability; ±2σ envelope ≈ unusual/extreme threshold. Bands are subordinate to the observed line (15-25% alpha, no border).
- **SPEI-3 / SPEI-12**: already standardised by the pipeline (log-logistic, ub-pwm). No σ bands. Reference lines at ±1, ±1.5, ±2 mark WMO drought/wet thresholds. Anomaly toggle hidden (SPEI is anomaly by construction).
- **SPEI season mapping**: for season MAM the value is the SPEI-3 at month = 5 (i.e. the 3-month accumulation ending in May represents Mar+Apr+May). Annual → SPEI-12 at month = 12. Independent of which SPEI scale is selected the system picks the month index from the season's last month.
- **Extreme highlighting**: `|z| > 2` or `|SPEI| > 1.5` flagged extreme; `|z| > 1` or `|SPEI| > 1` flagged unusual. Same colour palette as the existing `bars_extremeEvents` so the visual carries over.

### Controls

```{ojs}
viewof admin1_name = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return Inputs.select(["(country)"], { label: "Region (admin1)" });
  const resp = await db.query(`
    SELECT DISTINCT admin1_name FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm0URL.replace("adm0_obs","adm1_obs")}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}' AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
    ORDER BY admin1_name
  `);
  const options = ["(country)", ...Array.from(resp).map((d) => d.admin1_name)];
  return Inputs.select(options, { label: "Region (admin1)", value: "(country)" });
}

viewof variable_E = Inputs.select(
  ["TAVG", "TMAX", "TMIN", "PTOT", "SPEI-3", "SPEI-12"],
  { label: "Variable", value: "TAVG" }
);

viewof season_E = Inputs.select(
  ["annual","JFM","FMA","MAM","AMJ","MJJ","JJA","JAS","ASO","SON","OND","NDJ","DJF"],
  { label: "Season", value: "annual" }
);

viewof viewType_E = Inputs.select(
  ["periods", "monthly"],
  { label: "View Type", value: "periods", format: (d) => d === "periods" ? "Annual / season" : "Monthly" }
);

// Hidden when SPEI selected
viewof anomaly_E = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show as anomaly (vs 1991-2020)", value: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
isSPEI_E = variable_E.startsWith("SPEI");
// Use anomaly framing only for non-SPEI; SPEI is anomaly-by-construction
useAnomaly_E = anomaly_E && !isSPEI_E;

// Season → final-month-of-season mapping (for SPEI handling)
seasonLastMonth = ({
  annual: 12, JFM: 3, FMA: 4, MAM: 5, AMJ: 6, MJJ: 7, JJA: 8, JAS: 9,
  ASO: 10, SON: 11, OND: 12, NDJ: 1, DJF: 2,
});
```

### Timeseries

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Pull whichever parquet the active variable × view-type combo needs.
// For SPEI: ALWAYS monthly parquet, filtered to the season's last month.
// For TEMP/PTOT periods: admin-periods parquet, filtered to the season.
// For TEMP/PTOT monthly: admin-monthly parquet (12 months × years).
observed_E_raw = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return [];

  // Choose adm0 vs adm1 parquet based on selector
  const isAdmin1 = admin1_name !== "(country)";
  const baseURL = isAdmin1
    ? monthlyAdm0URL.replace("adm0_obs", "adm1_obs")
    : monthlyAdm0URL;
  const periodsURL = baseURL.replace("admin-monthly", "admin-periods");

  let q;
  if (isSPEI_E) {
    // Always monthly parquet for SPEI; filter to the season's last month
    const mo = seasonLastMonth[season_E];
    q = `
      SELECT year, month, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${baseURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${admin1_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND month = ${mo}
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year
    `;
  } else if (viewType_E === "monthly") {
    q = `
      SELECT year, month, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${baseURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${admin1_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year, month
    `;
  } else {
    // periods (annual / seasons)
    q = `
      SELECT year, value_mean
      FROM read_parquet('${periodsURL}')
      WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}'
        AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
        ${isAdmin1 ? `AND admin1_name = '${admin1_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : ""}
        AND variable = '${variable_E}'
        AND period = '${season_E}'
        AND value_mean IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(value_mean)
      ORDER BY year
    `;
  }
  const resp = await db.query(q);
  return Array.from(resp);
}

// Baseline statistics (1991-2020) over the same series.
baseline_E = {
  const baseline = observed_E_raw.filter((d) => d.year >= 1991 && d.year <= 2020);
  if (baseline.length === 0) return { mean: 0, sd: 0, n: 0 };
  const vals = baseline.map((d) => d.value_mean);
  const mean = d3.mean(vals);
  const sd = d3.deviation(vals) ?? 0;
  return { mean, sd, n: vals.length };
}

// Transform: apply anomaly framing (subtract baseline mean) when active.
observed_E = observed_E_raw.map((d) => {
  const v = useAnomaly_E ? d.value_mean - baseline_E.mean : d.value_mean;
  const z = baseline_E.sd > 0 ? (d.value_mean - baseline_E.mean) / baseline_E.sd : 0;
  // Extreme classification
  let cls = "normal";
  if (isSPEI_E) {
    const av = Math.abs(d.value_mean);
    if (av >= 1.5) cls = "extreme";
    else if (av >= 1) cls = "unusual";
  } else {
    const az = Math.abs(z);
    if (az >= 2) cls = "extreme";
    else if (az >= 1) cls = "unusual";
  }
  // For monthly view, add a year_frac for continuous x-axis
  const year_frac = d.month != null
    ? d.year + (d.month - 1) / 12
    : d.year;
  return { ...d, value_plot: v, z, cls, year_frac };
});
```

```{ojs}

// parens around the object literal when it sat at the end of a long

extremeColour_E = ({ normal: "#bbbbbb", unusual: "#f4a261", extreme: "#e15759" });
```

```{ojs}
recentChanges_E = {
  if (observed_E.length === 0) return html`<div style="padding: 1em; color: #999;">No data for this selection.</div>`;

  // y-axis label
  const unit = isSPEI_E ? "(z-score)"
    : variable_E === "PTOT" ? (viewType_E === "monthly" ? "(mm / month)" : "(mm / period)")
    : "(°C)";
  const yLabel = useAnomaly_E ? `${variable_E} anomaly ${unit}` : `${variable_E} ${unit}`;

  // Bands (only for non-SPEI)
  const meanForBands = useAnomaly_E ? 0 : baseline_E.mean;
  const bands = (!isSPEI_E && baseline_E.sd > 0) ? [
    { y1: meanForBands - 2 * baseline_E.sd, y2: meanForBands + 2 * baseline_E.sd, fill: "rgba(70,130,180,0.10)", label: "±2σ (unusual/extreme threshold)" },
    { y1: meanForBands - baseline_E.sd,     y2: meanForBands + baseline_E.sd,     fill: "rgba(70,130,180,0.18)", label: "±1σ (normal year-to-year variability)" },
  ] : [];

  // SPEI reference lines
  const speiLines = isSPEI_E ? [
    { y: -2,   stroke: "#e15759", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "−2 (extreme dry)" },
    { y: -1.5, stroke: "#e15759", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "−1.5 (severe dry)" },
    { y: -1,   stroke: "#f4a261", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "−1 (moderate dry)" },
    { y:  0,   stroke: "#999",    strokeDasharray: "1,2", label: "0 (baseline)" },
    { y:  1,   stroke: "#76b7b2", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "1 (moderate wet)" },
    { y:  1.5, stroke: "#76b7b2", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "1.5 (severe wet)" },
    { y:  2,   stroke: "#76b7b2", strokeDasharray: "2,3", label: "2 (extreme wet)" },
  ] : [];

  const xField = viewType_E === "monthly" || isSPEI_E && viewType_E === "monthly" ? "year_frac" : "year";

  return Plot.plot({
    width: 1200,
    height: 380,
    marginLeft: 70,
    marginBottom: 50,
    marginTop: 30,
    style: { color: "#333" },
    x: {
      label: "Year",
      tickFormat: (d) => `${Math.floor(d)}`,
    },
    y: {
      label: yLabel,
      grid: true,
      nice: true,
    },
    marks: [
      // baseline bands (rectangle spanning full x extent)
      ...bands.map((b) =>
        Plot.rect([b], { x1: d3.min(observed_E, (d) => d[xField]), x2: d3.max(observed_E, (d) => d[xField]), y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "fill" })
      ),
      // baseline mean line
      ...(!isSPEI_E ? [Plot.ruleY([meanForBands], { stroke: "#4682b4", strokeDasharray: "3,2" })] : []),
      // SPEI reference lines
      ...speiLines.map((l) =>
        Plot.ruleY([l.y], { stroke: l.stroke, strokeDasharray: l.strokeDasharray })
      ),
      // observed values — bars for SPEI, line + dot for others
      ...(isSPEI_E
        ? [
            Plot.barY(observed_E, {
              x: xField,
              y: "value_plot",
              fill: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              stroke: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              channels: { year: "year", value: "value_mean", classification: "cls" },
              tip: true,
            }),
          ]
        : [
            Plot.line(observed_E, {
              x: xField,
              y: "value_plot",
              stroke: "#333",
              strokeWidth: 1,
            }),
            Plot.dot(observed_E, {
              x: xField,
              y: "value_plot",
              r: 2.5,
              fill: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              stroke: (d) => extremeColour_E[d.cls],
              channels: { year: "year", value: "value_mean", anomaly: "value_plot", z: "z", classification: "cls" },
              tip: true,
            }),
          ]),
    ],
  });
}

// Caption summary
recentChanges_caption_E = {
  const speiMonth = isSPEI_E ? seasonLastMonth[season_E] : null;
  const region = admin1_name === "(country)" ? `${country.name} (national)` : `${admin1_name}, ${country.name}`;
  const baselineCopy = baseline_E.n > 0
    ? `Baseline (1991-2020): μ = ${baseline_E.mean.toFixed(2)}, σ = ${baseline_E.sd.toFixed(2)}, n = ${baseline_E.n} years.`
    : `Baseline (1991-2020): insufficient data.`;
  const speiCopy = isSPEI_E
    ? `SPEI is the ${variable_E.replace("SPEI-","")}-month accumulation ending in month ${speiMonth}. Reference lines: ±1 moderate, ±1.5 severe, ±2 extreme (WMO).`
    : "";
  return md`
*Region: **${region}** · Variable: **${variable_E}** · Season: **${season_E}** · View: **${viewType_E}**${useAnomaly_E ? " · **anomaly mode**" : ""}*

${baselineCopy} ${speiCopy}
  `;
}
```

### Map (interactive — Leaflet + georaster)

Renders the COG for the current (variable × season × clim=wmo_1991-2020 × stat=mean) as a raster overlay on a basemap. Admin0 polygon used as a pixel mask (transparent outside the country); a faint bbox rectangle marks the country envelope for context. **Admin1 selection does NOT filter the map** (we render the whole country and let the user see the spatial pattern); the admin1 dropdown only affects the timeseries above.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Leaflet via esm.sh (resolves peer deps better than jsdelivr — jsdelivr
// pulled quick-scale@0.1.0 which is missing createScaleFunction, breaking
// georaster-layer-for-leaflet@3.10.x).
L_E = (await import("https://esm.sh/leaflet@1.9.4")).default;

// CSS injection — Leaflet needs its CSS loaded
{
  if (!document.getElementById("leaflet-css-sandbox")) {
    const link = document.createElement("link");
    link.id = "leaflet-css-sandbox";
    link.rel = "stylesheet";
    link.href = "https://esm.sh/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }
}

parseGeoraster_E = (await import("https://esm.sh/georaster@1.6.0")).default;
GeoRasterLayer_E = (await import("https://esm.sh/georaster-layer-for-leaflet@3.10.4")).default;
topojsonClient_E = await import("https://esm.sh/topojson-client@3.1.0");
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Admin0 boundaries (topojson → geojson FeatureCollection)
admin0_geo_E = {
  const tj = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a0_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").json();
  const objectName = Object.keys(tj.objects)[0];
  return topojsonClient_E.feature(tj, tj.objects[objectName]);
}

// Country feature for the selected iso3
admin0_feature_E = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const f = admin0_geo_E.features.find((f) => f.properties && (f.properties.iso3 === iso3 || f.properties.ISO3 === iso3 || f.properties.iso_3 === iso3));
  return f ?? null;
}

// Variable → COG filename mapping (palette ramp picked per family)
cogURL_for_E = ({ variable, season, clim = "1995-2014", stat = "mean" }) => {
  // CR-076 — all COGs are physically in this one directory
  const dir = "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=climatology/variable=PTOT/period=AMJ/clim=wmo_1991-2020/stat=max";
  // The notebook eventually wants `1991-2020` to match the timeseries baseline. The
  // climatology bake currently emits 1995-2014 and 1991-2020 and full; use 1991-2020.
  return `${dir}/${variable}_${season}_1991-2020_${stat}.tif`;
}

variableRamp_E = ({
  TAVG:    [ [0,'#440154'], [15,'#3b528b'], [22,'#21918c'], [30,'#5ec962'], [40,'#fde725'] ],
  TMAX:    [ [0,'#440154'], [15,'#3b528b'], [25,'#21918c'], [35,'#5ec962'], [45,'#fde725'] ],
  TMIN:    [ [-5,'#440154'], [5,'#3b528b'], [15,'#21918c'], [25,'#5ec962'], [35,'#fde725'] ],
  PTOT:    [ [0,'#f7fbff'], [50,'#9ecae1'], [150,'#3182bd'], [300,'#08519c'], [500,'#08306b'] ],
  "SPEI-3":  [ [-2.5,'#67001f'], [-1,'#d6604d'], [-0.3,'#f7f7f7'], [0.3,'#f7f7f7'], [1,'#4393c3'], [2.5,'#053061'] ],
  "SPEI-12": [ [-2.5,'#67001f'], [-1,'#d6604d'], [-0.3,'#f7f7f7'], [0.3,'#f7f7f7'], [1,'#4393c3'], [2.5,'#053061'] ],
});

rgbInterp_E = (stops) => {
  const xs = stops.map((s) => s[0]);
  const cs = stops.map((s) => s[1]);
  const scale = d3.scaleLinear().domain(xs).range(cs).interpolate(d3.interpolateRgb).clamp(true);
  return (v) => {
    if (v == null || !isFinite(v)) return null;
    const rgb = d3.color(scale(v));
    if (!rgb) return null;
    return [rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b];
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
recentChangesMap_E = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const f = admin0_feature_E;

  const container = html`<div id="recent-changes-map-E" style="width: 100%; height: 460px; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #f5f5f5;"></div>`;

  // Defer map setup until after the container is in the DOM
  const setup = async () => {
    while (!document.getElementById("recent-changes-map-E")) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30));
    }
    const div = document.getElementById("recent-changes-map-E");
    div.innerHTML = "";

    const map = L_E.map(div, { zoomControl: true, attributionControl: true });
    L_E.tileLayer("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap, © CARTO",
      subdomains: "abcd",
      maxZoom: 19,
    }).addTo(map);

    // Country polygon outline
    if (f) {
      const layer = L_E.geoJSON(f, {
        style: { color: "#222", weight: 1.5, fill: false, dashArray: "4,3" },
      }).addTo(map);
      // Fit to country bounds (with padding)
      map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
      // Bbox rectangle (slightly larger than polygon)
      const b = layer.getBounds();
      L_E.rectangle(b, { color: "#888", weight: 1, fill: false, dashArray: "1,4" }).addTo(map);
    } else {
      map.setView([0, 20], 3);
    }

    // Load + render COG
    try {
      const cogUrl = cogURL_for_E({ variable: variable_E, season: season_E });
      const resp = await fetch(cogUrl);
      if (!resp.ok) {
        L_E.popup().setLatLng(map.getCenter()).setContent(
          `<b>COG not found</b><br>${cogUrl.split("/").pop()}<br>(HTTP ${resp.status})`
        ).openOn(map);
        return;
      }
      const ab = await resp.arrayBuffer();
      const georaster = await parseGeoraster_E(ab);
      const colourFn = rgbInterp_E(variableRamp_E[variable_E] ?? variableRamp_E.TAVG);
      const layer = new GeoRasterLayer_E({
        georaster,
        opacity: 0.78,
        resolution: 96,
        pixelValuesToColorFn: ([v]) => {
          const rgb = colourFn(v);
          return rgb ? `rgb(${rgb[0]},${rgb[1]},${rgb[2]})` : null;
        },
      });
      layer.addTo(map);
    } catch (e) {
      L_E.popup().setLatLng(map.getCenter()).setContent(`<b>Error loading COG</b><br>${String(e)}`).openOn(map);
    }
  };
  setup();
  return container;
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
**Map caveats** (sandbox scope):

- Pixel-mask via polygon clip is approximated by relying on the COG's NoData (ocean / outside-Africa pixels are already nan). True polygon-cut masking — using the admin0 boundary as a clip mask — would need either server-side `gdalwarp --cutline` (re-bake per country) or client-side canvas masking via the rendered tile + admin0 geometry. Deferred until the production view.
- COG URL is hard-coded to the CR-076 single-physical-directory layout. Once CR-076 lands the path template needs updating.
- Re-rendering on selector change is *full re-init* of the Leaflet map (cheap enough for sandbox; production view should swap the COG layer in place).
:::

## Quick row-count sanity check

```{ojs}
row_counts = {
  const iso3 = country.iso3;
  const gaul = mainGaul.get(iso3);
  if (gaul == null) return [];
  const resp = await db.query(`
    SELECT variable,
           COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
           MIN(year) AS min_year,
           MAX(year) AS max_year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN value_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null,
           SUM(CASE WHEN value_mean IS NOT NULL AND NOT isfinite(value_mean) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_inf
    FROM read_parquet('${monthlyAdm0URL}')
    WHERE iso3 = '${iso3}' AND gaul0_code = ${gaul}
    GROUP BY variable
    ORDER BY variable
  `);
  return Array.from(resp);
}

Inputs.table(row_counts, { width: 600 });
```
